points.description: States that the main removal mechanism is biological / bio-filtration (biological action by microorganisms), in any wording.
points.partial_credit: Half marks if only mentions the schmutzdecke / biological layer or microorganisms without naming biological action as the mechanism, or vaguely says filtration/straining.

points.description: Mentions the thin biological layer (schmutzdecke / hypogeal layer) on the sand surface formed by microorganisms, which removes bacteria/viruses.
points.partial_credit: Half of this point for mentioning only the surface layer or only the removal of bacteria/viruses.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying the main mechanism is biological action (bio-filtration) by microorganisms, ideally via the surface layer (schmutzdecke). Part marks if the answer only mentions the surface biological layer or microorganisms loosely, or is on the right track but vague. No marks for answers such as plain sedimentation, coagulation or chemical action only. Exact term 'schmutzdecke' is not required.
